core_meaning.primary_meaning: Naci corresponds to the Arabic form نَاجِي and is glossed in this record as “Survivor, saved.” The record associates the form with root ن ج و (n-j-w). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Naci corresponds to the Arabic form نَاجِي (Arabic root ن ج و (n-j-w); نَاجِي (Nājī)). Its core sense is naci; survivor, saved (turkish form). Naci is the Turkish form of Arabic نَاجِي (Nājī), the active participle of نَجَا, meaning 'survivor, saved'.
